summary: The presence collector can run on a Life360 browser token when Life360 refuses its password login.
details: A new optional LIFE360_AUTH_TOKEN is used as the collector's Life360 token; with it set, the password is never sent.
A rejected token is reported on its own (the token_rejected alarm) and backs off instead of retrying the password.
limitations: The token is copied by hand from a life360.com browser login, and must be replaced by hand when Life360 stops accepting it.
